scope: Historical 12-source development set, 24 paired views; no fresh inference
metric_limitations: EM is diagnostic, not adjudicated correctness or hallucination. No human ratings.

asr_attributable_recovery.reason: Pilot has no matched gold-transcript control. Historical oracle has different prompt/decoding and cannot be joined as if matched.

parameter_count.buffers: uncertainty_mean and uncertainty_std are buffers, not trainable parameters
parameter_count.qualification: Runtime count and explicit layer shape calculation agree. This audit does not reload pretrained models or checkpoints.

input_and_objective_audit.question: Separately supplied written Hindi question about factual speech, not a gold transcription of a spoken question
input_and_objective_audit.question_embedding: Masked mean of frozen Qwen input-token embeddings; word-order information is lost
input_and_objective_audit.audio_features: Frozen Whisper encoder, predicted-token DTW blocks, not reference-aligned test spans
input_and_objective_audit.training: Answer-token CE only, no KD/alignment warmup in completed pilot
input_and_objective_audit.gate: Already implemented sigmoid gate and fixed acoustic prefix insertion; zero-logit gate is 0.5, not a near-zero corrective initialization
input_and_objective_audit.candidate_coverage: Dependent on emitted tokens; deletion/degenerate-alignment regions may be unrepresented
input_and_objective_audit.budget: Trained K=4; K=8 unsupported by current constructor. Any new budget experiment requires versioned implementation/protocol and matched training.
